# Import YouTube
Imports a YouTube video as an entity with an asset holding its thumbnail and tags.
## When to use
- A user or scenario provides a YouTube video link to add to the library.
## How it works
1. Parses `url`. Only single videos are imported. 2. Loads the title, description, thumbnail and tags from the YouTube Data API. 3. Creates or updates the entity in `moduleid` (matched by `embeddedid`) and an asset in its upload folder, and links the asset as the entity's primary media. 4. Fires `fetchassetadded`.
## Inputs
- `url`: YouTube video URL - `moduleid`: Module to create the entity in, default entityvideo - `youtube-data-api-key`: YouTube Data API key
## Outputs
- The entity and its asset
## Implementation
- Bean `youtubeImporterSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.YoutubeImporterSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

# Face Detection
Detects faces in a set of assets.
## When to use
- Assets need face detection outside the informatics pipeline.
## How it works
1. Meant to run face detection on the assets in the context. The informatics `facedetect` row (bean faceProfileSkill) does this today.
## Inputs
None. It does not read any values from the agent context.
## Notes
- No Spring bean named `faceDetectionAgent` is registered in plugin.xml, so this skill cannot run yet. The closest implementation is `FaceProfileSkill (bean faceProfileSkill)`.
## Implementation
- Bean `faceDetectionAgent`: not registered - Agent type: `taskagent`

data.name: Markdown to HTML
data.markdowncontent:
--- name: markdownToHtmlSkill description: Converts markdown text to HTML. ---
# Markdown to HTML
Converts markdown text to HTML.
## When to use
- Generated markdown must be shown on a page, emailed, or saved as HTML.
## How it works
1. Renders `markdowncontent` with MarkdownUtil. 2. Stores the HTML in `html` and as the last response, then runs the children. 3. If `markdowncontent` is missing, sets `html` to an empty string and stops.
## Inputs
- `markdowncontent`: The markdown text to convert
## Outputs
- `html`, `markdown` (the MarkdownUtil instance)
## Implementation
- Bean `markdownToHtmlSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.MarkdownToHtmlSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`
